{{Quote|I take it the ''Smelly Saint'' and ''Bella's Bosom'' are ships?''"<br />"''The ''Saint'' runs ripoff copy agri-droids out of the Kimm systems, sometimes slaves from the Senex Sector.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="CotJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>}}
The '''Kimm systems''' referred to a trio of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], each with a shabby industrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the same name: [[Kimm Aurek]], [[Kimm Besh]], and [[Kimm Cresh]]. These three worlds belonged to [[House Sreethyn]] of the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]].<ref name="TEA" /> The systems produced rip-off [[Agrirobot/Legends|agri-droids]]<ref name="CotJ" /> and shared their name with the epithet "[[Nemesis of the Kimm]]," one of the many titles bestowed upon the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sharad Hett]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|369|Nemesis of the Kimm}}</ref> by [[47 BBY/Legends|47 BBY]].<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>
